recentItems.title: Over 700 cardholders report unauthorised iPhone pre-order charges in Hong Kong
recentItems.description:
Hong Kong police have received reports from more than 700 people about unauthorised credit card transactions linked to pre-orders of Apple’s newest iPhones. The charges, worth a combined HK$14.7 million (US$1.87 million), have prompted an investigation by police and major banks.

recentItems.title: Nepal tunnel flood survivor reunited with family
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Sanjay Sah, a Nepali flood survivor, has been reunited with his family after being rescued 10 days after he was trapped inside the upper Trishuli 3A hydropower station tunnel. Sah survived on floodwater and seepage from rock debris until rescuers finally reached him. As search and rescue operations continue, Sah urged authorities not to give up.

recentItems.title: New device helps stroke survivors walk more naturally
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Scientists have developed a lightweight, battery-free device that can stimulate the nervous system and help improve the mobility of stroke survivors with impaired movement and walking instability. Developed by researchers in Hong Kong and in mainland China, the device harvests energy from the wearer’s own movements to power targeted electrical stimulations, helping a user lift their weaker foot and restoring a more natural walking pattern.

recentItems.title: 130 missing after ferry sinks in Indonesia
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Indonesian authorities are searching for 130 missing passengers after the ferry Virgo Transport 8 sank in the Java Sea during bad weather on Sunday. The vessel was travelling from Surabaya to Banjarmasin with 240 people aboard when it encountered rough seas before issuing a distress signal. Rescuers have saved 107 survivors and recovered six bodies so far.

recentItems.title: Is it time to revisit Hong Kong’s dangerous dog laws?
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Read the latest: https://sc.mp/rv1z9 

Hong Kong authorities have stepped up checks on large dogs in public places to ensure they are properly leashed. A three-day operation ending in early September yielded three suspected cases of big dogs who were not restrained. The operation was prompted by recent fatal dog attacks in the city. Hong Kong’s Agricultural, Fisheries and Conservation Department is also looking into whether further requirements are needed to identify potential dangerous dogs.

recentItems.title: Why some Chinese F&B chains have exited Hong Kong
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Mainland Chinese food and beverage chains have aggressively expanded into Hong Kong in recent years, but some are now hitting major roadblocks. Global beverage and dessert chain Mixue downsized its business in Hong Kong, while other brands like Fufuland and Ningji exited the Hong Kong market. Hong Kong’s relatively high rent and labour costs have been a challenge for many of the businesses, which normally rely on a high-volume, low-price business model common in mainland China.

recentItems.title: Robots protest to demand AI regulation
recentItems.description:
About 30 robots holding flags and chanting slogans have staged a protest outside Poland’s digital affairs ministry in Warsaw to demand improved AI regulation. Democratism, the advocacy group that organised Monday’s event, said the robotic rally aimed to spark debate about the impact of AI and robotics on the labour market.

recentItems.title: Rebuilt bridge in flood-ravaged Nepal restores hope
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Nepali authorities have completed a new bridge over the Tadi river, reconnecting the town of Devighat with Kathmandu. The span replaces a bridge that was swept away by devastating flash flooding caused by the collapse of a glacier last month. The new connection has restored access to essential supplies and is bringing renewed hope to local communities.
